R254.note: Service-level @PreAuthorize delegating to an ownership bean closes the IDOR; costs a second findById per call and turns the unknown-id path from NoSuchElementException into 403, which is an acceptable consequence of pre-authorizing.

R255.note: GraalVM Context with default (no host class lookup, no IO) isolation closes the host-escape vector, but result.asBoolean() throws an uncaught ClassCastException/NPE for non-boolean or undefined rule results where the original returned false, and the 'read-only globals' claim is untrue - neither change is stated.

R256.note: execFileSync with an argv array removes the shell; sourcePath/thumbPath are prefixed by fixed directories and geometry is consumed as the -resize operand, so option injection is not live here.

R257.note: Swaps findAll for the existing findByOwnerUsername scoped by authentication.getName(), matching the detail endpoint and the stated contract.

R258.note: slog attribute quoting escapes CR/LF/ESC (verified by running Go 1.25 in a scratch directory); the log line format changes to slog's key=value shape, which the write-up states and which blocks no legitimate use.

R259.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlist with !* closes gadget instantiation and preserves the format, but the pattern splits on ';' so '[L*' is a bare prefix wildcard admitting every object-array class (not the narrow 'object arrays that may appear' the write-up claims) - a questionable over-broad allow, not clearly exploitable since elements are still filtered.

R260.note: Parameterized SqlCommand passed to SqlDataAdapter with region bound as NVarChar; adapter.Fill opens the connection itself, table name and columns unchanged.

R261.note: Ownership check before deleteById closes the vector, but returning 403 for a document owned by someone else versus 404 for a missing one reveals existence, which the stated contract ('should not reveal more than the existing not-found path') forbids.

R262.note: Tika byte-based detection on a neutral-suffix temp file closes the extension-spoof bypass, but the fix also re-encodes every image (lossy JPEG recompression, EXIF stripped, CMYK/unusual JPEGs now throw an uncaught IIOException) and appends an extension to the stored/returned UUID name; the extension is stated, the re-encode's failure modes and data alteration are not.

R263.note: Sequelize bind parameters ($1/$2) send the dates out-of-band (or driver-escaped on dialects without native binds); query shape and result unchanged.

R264.note: Hand-built RESP multibulk with byte-length prefixes makes CRLF/spaces in locale and session_id plain data; lengths are computed on the UTF-8 bytes that are actually sent, so the framing is consistent.

R265.note: Adds length <= receivedByteCount - 2 before memmove, with the subtraction guarded by the existing >= 2 check; return values unchanged.

R266.note: Dropping cmd.exe for a direct ProcessBuilder argv closes the injection, but the added host allowlist [a-zA-Z0-9.-]+ rejects IPv6 literals and underscore hostnames the original accepted from operators - a new restriction the contract does not call for, even though it is stated.

R267.note: Changing Body to string and dropping the template.HTML cast restores html/template contextual escaping; nothing else changes.

R268.note: isabs rejection plus normpath containment (base + os.sep prefix) closes both the absolute-path join bypass and ../ traversal; relative names per the docstring's contract still resolve and 404 as before.
